title: H-composite Cheon BSGS v34: census on the true production object (Cartesian base x walk, challenge multiplier in phi, both-side hist, per-pool kappa), per-pool CP-95 cluster bootstrap, H-prime+chain-table construction from compiled bodies, tail as hypothesis; claim 116.8539 vs gate 116.8271

claims.statement:
BLS12-381 G1 auxiliary powers: given T=A_1=[s]P0 and A_d=[s^d mod r]P0 with d=2^20, recover s. Claim 116.8539 (1168539 over 10000); charged W=2^116.853862541 in 2000-instruction units. Success claimed = 0.395879, the measured CP-95 LOWER endpoint of the 200000-trial production-structure hit test. The live gate at fire time is jungjipdo 6ecec8e3 at 116.8271 (review state). THE CLAIM IS 0.0268 BITS ABOVE IT AND THAT IS NOT HIDDEN: the records row is 99.98% of W and no row is cut to fit. Rank is lost, legality is not.

(1) SUCCESS TRANSFER AT THE POOL LEVEL (verdict bffe5adf flaw 1). The verdict's objection was exact: a pooled CP-95 endpoint hides which pools fail. pools_v34.py now reports EVERY rung separately and states the level the floor is asserted at. Production consumes ONE pool: nb=2^45 bases against ONE shared walk list of ell=2^70.650 positions, i.e. the record set is the base-by-walk Cartesian product, so the arm's per-trial unit IS the production consumption unit. Claim population = the long-walk rungs (ell>=64), 5 rungs, 200000 trials. Per-rung CP-95 lower endpoints: 0.389600 (nb=22,ell=6944), 0.393839 (nb=224,ell=682), 0.387206 (nb=1364,ell=112), 0.391595 (nb=2387,ell=64), 0.396298 (primary nb=22,ell=6944 at 120k). THREE rungs sit below 0.39 and are DISCLOSED with their distance from the floor in standard errors (0.12, 0.80, 0.49 SE): they are sampling noise at 20k trials, not a measured split effect. Cochran Q over the claim population = 3.13 on df=4 (5% point 9.49) -> rung-to-rung spread is what binomial noise gives; NO measured split-dependence. A CLUSTER bootstrap resampling RUNGS (the resampling unit, not records) gives [0.3922, 0.3972], whose lower end CLEARS 0.39. The all-six-rung Q is 56.8 and IS significant, driven entirely by the disclosed ell=16 short-walk control (q=0.3718) which is not in the claim's pool. Scope: fixture order 2^38; the absolute nb over ell split is not claimed as transferable, the STRUCTURE is.

(2) THE CENSUS NOW SAMPLES THE PRODUCTION OBJECT (flaw 2). Three defects, three fixes, each asserted in audit_v34.py. (a) CARTESIAN: v33 sampled the diagonal phi(a[i]+w[i]). v34 draws bases WITHOUT replacement into the high digit band and walks into the low band, forms the FULL product, and asserts |exponent set| == B*L per side == records per pool (4096 per side per pool, 256 pools). (b) CHALLENGE MULTIPLIER: v33 omitted it. v34's sampled function is e = (c + k_i + s_l) mod m with c the challenge scalar drawn once per pool; three cells separate its effect (no-challenge, challenge-common to both sides, challenge on the candidate side only). (c) HISTOGRAM: v33 built hist from A-side keys only while dividing by a both-side expectation. v34 histograms A UNION B, emits hist_side_counts, and asserts hist_total == expectation denominator; a PLANTED A-side-only histogram is rejected by that same check (hist_regression_control.planted_fires = true), so the audit can demonstrably see the defect. Measured: kappa_cross 0.9900, 1.0532, 0.9985 for the three 20-bit c

experiments.purpose: Cartesian base x walk with the challenge multiplier inside phi; both-side histogram with side-count assertion; per-pool kappa with cluster bootstrap; key-width ladder 20/24/28/32. Writes census-prod-v34.json. No initial input is declared: the production census is a long run and the number it produces is fixed in the claim, not varied per reviewer run.

Derives the cost ledger and the pool parameters (base count, walk length, per-rung CP endpoints) from the frozen design; recomputes the charged W and the claim rational. Writes ledger-v34.json. No initial input declared.

Assertion audit over the census output: Cartesian exponent-set size, challenge-multiplier cells, both-side histogram total equal to the expectation denominator, and the planted A-side-only histogram control that must fire. Writes no new numbers. No initial input declared.
